# `csharp_space_between_method_call_parameter_list_parentheses`

Space just inside the parentheses of an argument list.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine( "hello" );
        Math.Max( 1, 2 );
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("hello");
        Math.Max(1, 2);
    }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_space_between_method_call_parameter_list_parentheses = true`

```ini
csharp_space_between_method_call_parameter_list_parentheses = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        Console.WriteLine( "hello" );
        Math.Max( 1, 2 );
    }
}
```
